plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
runtime: node 22, express, PostgreSQL 18 (openvibe-sdk/db, async) + Valkey 9, node-media-server 2.7.4, ffmpeg

protocols.restream: RTMP source to RTMP/RTMPS/SRT destinations ported (openre-restream-worker)
protocols.webrtc: worker ported (workers/webrtc.js + workers/webrtc/{sfu,sdp,signaling}.js, run by openre-webrtc@): WHIP (RFC 9725) ingest by key on the mediasoup SFU, browser broadcasters over /b/<key> and viewers over /w/<playback id>, loopback RTP egress for restream/recording/thumbnails, recording through Media's RTP ingest; generations/leases/drain; refuses to start in production without MEDIASOUP_ANNOUNCED_IP
protocols.jsmpeg: worker ported (workers/jsmpeg.js): MPEG-TS POST admission by key, WS viewers, loopback data tap, restream (re-encode), generations/drain; no recording (parity)

livePatch: applied in Live f0ca18b and deployed; Live wired on 2026-09-23 (OPENRE_URL and the openre.session.* subscription, docs/cutover.md phase A); every Live slot keeps ingest_authority=live until its per-slot cutover (phase B), so no broadcaster uses OpenRe yet
deployment: Deployed with `sudo ovhost deploy openre` (OpenVibe.Host strategy release-layout since the 2026-09-27 cutover; deploy/scripts/deploy.sh is the wrapper and keeps workers/status/prune): API + coordinator on 127.0.0.1:4500, RTMP ingest public on 0.0.0.0:1936 (ingest.openre.stream, DNS-only; reachable from outside since 2026-09-23), Live wired (OPENRE_URL, openre.session.* subscription), preflight all PASS, restore drill passed. No slot switched yet: every slot is still ingested by Live until the per-slot cutover (docs/cutover.md phase B).
features: stream definitions owned by a Network subject, with typed references
ingest keys hashed at rest, shown once, rotation with grace
RTMP ingest workers with generations, leases and drains that survive API deploys
RTMP/RTMPS/SRT restream with output health and a circuit breaker
outbox events openre.session.*, openre.output.*, openre.recording.requested, openre.key.rotated
migration from Live without importing old keys
